reasons: Candidate blocks with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, but the OpenTelemetry redis receiver defines redis.clients.connected (gauge, count of connected clients), which measures the same quantity as Datadog redis.net.clients.
otel_metric_definitions is empty, so the mapping is not verifiable from the supplied catalog; confirm redis.clients.connected is in the catalog before accepting the block.

If the mapping exists, the exact translation would be a gauge selector {otel_metric_name="redis.clients.connected", otel_metric_type="gauge"} with no rate(), the host filter as host_name=~"$host" (label name to be confirmed against observed dataset labels), and the scope variable dropped, since it has no prefix and defaults to *.

The key variable has prefix key and default *, so it would become a matcher on the key label only if that label is observed in the dataset; otherwise it should be treated per the dataset's observed labels.
